primary_endpoint: Relative liver fat reduction assessed by MRI-PDFF at week 36.
efficacy_outcome: At OLE week 36, MRI-PDFF decreased by a mean 11.1% (SE 1.5%; P < 0.0001), corresponding to a 52.3% mean relative reduction (SE 4.4%; P < 0.0001) from baseline.
safety_signal: Well tolerated, with few nonserious adverse events.
